senses.gloss:
उचित, अस्, आ, अम्, delightful, pleasurable, agreeable;
customary, usual; proper, suitable, convenient; ac-
ceptable, fit or right to be taken; known, under-
stood; intrusted, deposited; measured, adjusted,
accurate; delighting in, used to.

उच्चि उच्-चि (उद्-चि), cl. 5. P. A. -चिनोति, -नुते,
-चेतुम्, to gather, collect.

उच्चिङ्गट उच्चिङ्गट, अस्, m. a passionate or
angry man; a kind of crab; a sort of cricket. See
उच्चिटिङ्ग, चिङ्गट, चिच्चिटिङ्ग.

उच्चिटिङ्ग उच्चिटिङ्ग, अस्, m. a small poison-
ous animal living in water, a crab; [cf. the last.]
